items.item_text: M.A. or Ph.D. in related field of study
Experience in wilderness studies or related fields
Prepare and teach courses as described and assigned
Discuss class progress with the program coordinator, including teaching performance through observation
Collaborate with other faculty as needed
Demonstrate a commitment to serving and inspiring students in an academic context that integrates your Christian faith and learning

Embrace the mission, vision , and values of Fresno Pacific University, affirm the FPU Faith Expectations (Download PDF reader) , and support the ideals and practices articulated in " The Fresno Pacific Idea ”
Commitment to the Christian faith and the University’s mission of Christ-centered teaching and learning and involvement in a local church.
Outdoor settings as the primary learning space, with exposure to cold, heat, darkness, varying wilderness landscapes, etc.
Frequently work at a fast pace with unscheduled interruptions.
Drive personal or University vehicles to classes.
Public contact position requiring professional apparel, personal hygiene, and grooming.

Outdoor setting for wilderness studies courses with exposure to varying temperatures, as well as other weather-related and climatic exposures which may include wind, rain, snow, and elevation changes.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, or hike for up to three hours continuously, carry a backpack weighing up to 50 pounds, and demonstrate basic techniques related to hiking, bouldering, sheltering, and evacuation of self and others.
Reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities will be provided in accordance with law.
Ability to work with students, staff, and faculty in a collegial environment

The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Employee must be able to communicate with others to exchange information including both over the telephone and in-person communication with callers and community members and be able to read a computer screen and paper documents.
